title: hass_renpho: smart-scale data in Home Assistant

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Step on a smart scale, and your weight and body measurements show up as sensors in your smart home. That's the idea behind hass_renpho.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So it's a Home Assistant add-on for Renpho scales?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, a custom integration, and Antoine's repository is a fork of it. It decodes the biometric readings from Renpho scales and turns them into Home Assistant entities.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A shared coordinator refreshes the data from the cloud API on a schedule. Then individual sensor entities expose that state, so every measurement is its own sensor you can chart or automate with.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: One refresh feeding many sensors. Neat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It's almost all Python, and the upstream author is credited.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The written note has the component details.
